insight: Built for physical-world and medical AI: labels DICOM, NIfTI, LiDAR point clouds and SAR alongside images and video, not just photos.
name: Encord
tagline: Data platform to curate, label, and manage AI training data.
description: An enterprise data development platform for preparing high-quality training data across images, video, documents, audio, DICOM, and 3D point clouds. It pairs AI-assisted labeling (SAM auto-segmentation, object tracking) with data curation, model evaluation, and workflow tooling, plus LLM-powered data agents for document tasks. Used heavily in medical imaging, robotics, and other physical-AI domains.

modelSupport.notes: Integrates foundation models (e.g. SAM) for AI-assisted labeling and frontier LLMs for document data agents.
